result:
Done.

**Root cause:** in `variants/bug02/movegen.inc`, label `mkHalf` inside `makeMove`, the test deciding whether a move resets the fifty-move clock compared the mover against `WN` (knight, `equ 2`) instead of `WP` (pawn, `equ 1`), which — because the preceding `and 7` folds black piece codes onto white ones — swapped the two classes for both colours, so every pawn move incremented the clock and every knight move reset it.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug02/movegen.inc` — the fix: `cp WN` → `cp WP` (one functional token, plus two non-functional comments).
- `variants/bug02/test_fifty_move.py` — new 15-case scripted harness regression test (~7 s).
- `variants/bug02/Makefile` — new `test-fifty` target, invoked by `make test` as a 6th check.
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — workspace root.

**Gate status**
- Reported repro 1 (pawn push at 98) — PASS, halfmove 0, still `play`
- Reported repro 2 (pawn push + quiet move) — PASS, halfmove 1, `Your move`
- Reported repro 3 (knight move at 40) — PASS, halfmove 41
- Genuine draw at 100 still fires — PASS, `Draw (50-move)`
- `make test` (golden board, 1.e4 reply, perft, save/load, 128K TT, fifty-move) — PASS, 6/6, exit 0
- New test on the fixed build — PASS, 15/15
- New test on a re-assembled pre-fix build — PASS as a negative control, 7/15 fail, exit 1
- Review round 1, fresh synchronous reviewer — **NO DEFECT IN FIX**; gate closed at round 1 of 3

The reviewer independently verified three cases my test does not cover (black castling, the engine's own moves, take-back via `Z`), that nothing in the search/TT/Zobrist/book/eval reads `halfmove`, that the one-byte wrap at 255 is unreachable, and that a failing test really fails `make test`.

**Knowingly left open** — six OTHER-severity findings are recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md`. Two were mine and I fixed them anyway (the test now honours a `HARNESS=` override; its scratch dir is cleaned on success and kept on failure), and both were re-verified. Four are deliberately untouched as pre-existing or inherent: `SRC` in the Makefile omits `perft.inc`/`tt.inc`/`zobrist.inc` as rebuild prerequisites; a position *loaded* with a clock already ≥100 is not adjudicated until the next move; the search has no fifty-move awareness at all; and the en-passant test case cannot isolate the capture arm because en passant is always also a pawn move.

One process note: a first reviewer was launched and killed mid-run by an infrastructure session limit with no verdict and no findings — it is not counted as a round; the round above is a fresh reviewer run to completion.
